# Combobox: `jl-combobox`

A text field with a list of options that narrows as people type.

- Class `JlCombobox`, a molecule: `import { JlCombobox } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/combobox

A text field with a list under it: typing narrows the list (case and accents do not matter, and
labels that start with the text come first), the arrows move through it, Enter or a click chooses. The field then
shows the option's label, while value and the form hold its value. An Enter that chooses nothing (the list closed,
nothing typed) submits the form, as from a native field.

Without allow-custom, leaving the field with text no option has brings the chosen label back; with it, that text
becomes the value. Listen to input to load options from a server as people type, and set them with options.set().

## Use

```ts
import { JlCombobox } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlCombobox
  clearable
  label="City"
  options={[{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Zürich","value":"zrh"},{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Genève","value":"gva"},{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Lausanne","value":"lsn"},{"description":"Portugal","label":"Lisbon","value":"lis"},{"description":"Denmark","label":"Copenhagen","value":"cph"},{"description":"Japan","label":"Kyoto","value":"kyo"},{"description":"Canada","label":"Montréal","value":"yul"},{"description":"New Zealand","label":"Wellington","value":"wlg"}]}
  placeholder="Search a city"
/>
```

```html
<jl-combobox
  clearable
  label="City"
  options='[{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Zürich","value":"zrh"},{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Genève","value":"gva"},{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Lausanne","value":"lsn"},{"description":"Portugal","label":"Lisbon","value":"lis"},{"description":"Denmark","label":"Copenhagen","value":"cph"},{"description":"Japan","label":"Kyoto","value":"kyo"},{"description":"Canada","label":"Montréal","value":"yul"},{"description":"New Zealand","label":"Wellington","value":"wlg"}]'
  placeholder="Search a city"
></jl-combobox>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `options` (attribute `options`): `ComboboxOption[]`, default `[]`. The choices: value, label, and optionally a description and disabled.
- `value` (attribute `value`): `string`, default `''`. The chosen option's value; with allow-custom, any text.
- `placeholder` (attribute `placeholder`): `string`, default `''`. Shown while the field is empty.
- `allowCustom` (attribute `allow-custom`): `boolean`, default `false`. Text no option has as its label becomes the value.
- `clearable` (attribute `clearable`): `boolean`, default `false`. A button empties the field while it holds text.
- `emptyText` (attribute `empty-text`): `string`, default `''`. What the list says when no option matches. Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, default `'md'`. The height.
- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The field's name in the form's data.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The accessible name, when no visible label names the field.
- `required` (attribute `required`): `boolean`, default `false`. The form cannot be submitted without a value.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Cannot be changed or focused.
- `invalid` (attribute `invalid`): `boolean`, default `false`. Drawn in the danger colour, for an error the page found.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `string`: An option was chosen, the free text was taken, or the field was cleared.
- `input` (`onInput` in JSX), detail `string`: Each change of the typed text, to fetch options for it.

## Methods

- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the text field.
- `checkValidity(): boolean`: Whether a required combobox has a value.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The frame around the text field.
- `list` (part, `::part(list)`): The floating list of options.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Search a list

Type "ge" or "zu": the matching part is highlighted, accents or not.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-combobox label="City" placeholder="Search a city" clearable options='[{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Zürich","value":"zrh"},{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Genève","value":"gva"},{"description":"Switzerland","label":"Lausanne","value":"lsn"},{"description":"Portugal","label":"Lisbon","value":"lis"},{"description":"Denmark","label":"Copenhagen","value":"cph"},{"description":"Japan","label":"Kyoto","value":"kyo"},{"description":"Canada","label":"Montréal","value":"yul"},{"description":"New Zealand","label":"Wellington","value":"wlg"}]'></jl-combobox>
</div>
```

### Descriptions and disabled options

A second line explains each option; a disabled one shows but cannot be chosen.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-combobox label="Plan" value="pro" options='[{"description":"One project, community support","label":"Hobby","value":"hobby"},{"description":"Unlimited projects, email support","label":"Pro","value":"pro"},{"description":"Single sign-on, audit logs, a named contact","label":"Enterprise","value":"enterprise"},{"description":"No longer sold","disabled":true,"label":"Legacy","value":"legacy"}]'></jl-combobox>
</div>
```

### Free text

With allow-custom, a name nobody has is a value too. The paragraph listens to change.

```html
<div class="stack narrow">
  <jl-combobox class="demo-assign" label="Assignee" placeholder="Name or email" allow-custom clearable options='[{"label":"Ada Lovelace","value":"ada"},{"label":"Grace Hopper","value":"grace"},{"label":"Margaret Hamilton","value":"margaret"}]'></jl-combobox>
  <p class="muted demo-assign-out">Nobody assigned.</p>
</div>
```

```js
const combobox = root.querySelector('.demo-assign');
const out = root.querySelector('.demo-assign-out');
combobox.events.register('change', (value) => {
  out.textContent = value === '' ? 'Nobody assigned.' : `Assigned to ${value}.`;
});
```

### Options from a server

The options come from a pretend server, a moment after each keystroke.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-combobox class="demo-remote" label="Language" placeholder="Type a language" empty-text="No language by that name"></jl-combobox>
</div>
```

```js
// LANGUAGES: [{ value: 'rust', label: 'Rust' }, …]
const combobox = root.querySelector('.demo-remote');
combobox.events.register('input', (text) => {
  setTimeout(() => {
    const query = text.toLowerCase();
    combobox.options.set(LANGUAGES.filter((option) => option.value.includes(query)));
  }, 250);
});
```
